artworks.title: Gilles
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. W. Murray Crane
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing on a decorative platform. The individual has a serene facial expression with short, curly hair, wearing a long-sleeved outfit. The setting includes elaborate drapery and floral motifs, along with decorative elements like trees and curtains. A human face surrounded by foliage is depicted in the lower section. The scene is detailed and monochromatic.

artworks.title: Seated Woman Playing a Guitar
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. W. Murray Crane
artworks.description: The image shows a woman playing a guitar while seated on a decorative ledge. She has a serene expression, with detailed facial features and an elaborate hairstyle. She wears an elegant, flowing dress with a fitted bodice and long sleeves. The background is ornate, featuring floral garlands, urns with plants, and intricate scrollwork. A decorative archway and other decorative elements complete the scene.

artworks.title: Shepherd and Shepherdess (?)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. W. Murray Crane
artworks.description: The image shows a man and a woman positioned at the center. The man stands holding a staff and wearing a hat, coat, and knee-length pants. The woman stands next to him with her head tilted upwards and wearing an elegant gown. The background features decorative scrolls, foliage, and a basket of flowers. The scene is embellished with luxurious patterns and ornate details.

artworks.title: LeMay
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. W. Murray Crane
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate decorative design featuring a pastoral scene and symmetrical motifs. The central section of the drawing depicts a woman sitting on a rock surrounded by trees, addressing two figures holding pastoral staffs in a pleasant landscape. Above, an ornate architectural structure resembling a circular pavilion is depicted, adorned with floral arrangements and scrollwork. The entire composition is framed with intricate lines and plant motifs. At the bottom, a medallion portrays a landscape featuring a river and a distant village.

artworks.title: François Séverin Marceau-Desgraviers
artworks.medium: color etching, wash manner, and aquatint on wove paper
artworks.dimensions:
image: 43.1 × 32 cm (16 15/16 × 12 5/8 in.)
sheet (trimmed within platemark): 49.9 × 36.5 cm (19 5/8 × 14 3/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. W. Murray Crane
artworks.description: The image shows two figures, one standing and the other kneeling. The standing figure is a young man shown from head to toe, while the kneeling figure's upper body and head are visible. The standing man is positioned slightly leaning forward with his arm extended. He has a mustache and long wavy hair that extends to his shoulders, partially covered by a large feathered military hat. He wears a dark blue military coat with gold detailing, a red sash, and tall black boots. To his side is a scabbard with a visible handle. The kneeling figure has long hair and is dressed in dark military attire with a sword in hand, gazing up at the standing man. The background shows a rugged landscape with rocky outcrops and a distant group of soldiers in blue uniforms. The sky overhead is depicted in shades of blue and grey.

artworks.title: Joachim Murat (Joachim-Napoleon, Roi de Naples et de Sicile, Grand-Admiral de France)
artworks.artist: Louis Charles Ruotte after Albert Jakob Frans Gregorius after Antoine-Jean Gros
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. W. Murray Crane
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body depiction of a man in a formal, military portrait. He is facing slightly to the right, while his head is turned towards the left. The man has a pronounced jawline with sideburns and curly, dark hair styled with volume. He is dressed in an ornate military uniform, featuring a prominent blue coat with gold epaulettes, a red sash draped diagonally across his chest, and a decorative star emblem on the left breast. A golden rope accentuates his waist. He wears a high-collared shirt beneath the coat. The background is subtle, with a soft gradient transitioning from darker to lighter shades, without any prominent features. The bottom of the image contains text identifying the person as JOACHIM-NAPOLÉON, ROI DE NAPLES ET DE SICILE, with a detailed crest centered below.

artworks.title: Marie Antoinette d'Autriche Reine de France
artworks.medium: etching and stipple with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. W. Murray Crane
artworks.description: The image features a portrait of a woman facing forward with her head slightly turned to the right. She has fair skin, soft facial features, and elaborately styled hair with feathers and a headdress. She wears typical 18th-century noblewoman attire with a high-collared blouse, lace ruffle, richly decorated bodice, pearls around her neck, and drop earrings. The background includes an oval frame with a patterned design and text identifying the subject as Marie Antoinette, with her title and birth details.

artworks.title: Charles Henri, Comte d'Estaing
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. W. Murray Crane
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a standing position. He has an oval face with rosy cheeks, clean-shaven, with gray curly hair. He is wearing a military uniform with gold embroidery, epaulettes, a red waistcoat, an embroidered sash, and military medals. The man is holding a paper in his right hand and has his left hand tucked into his coat. Nearby, there are papers on a table with a globe. In the background, there is a curtain and a scene depicting ships on a body of water, partially obscured by smoke.

artworks.title: Josephine Impératrice des Français et Reine d'Italie (Josephine, Empress of the French and Queen of Italy)
artworks.medium: stipple engraving inked à la poupée with hand coloring on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. W. Murray Crane
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of a woman facing forward with her head turned slightly to the right. She has fair skin, delicate facial features, a small smiling mouth, and dark eyes. Her dark hair is styled in soft curls with some pulled back and adorned with a golden crown featuring pearls. She wears an ornate dress with a high white collar, a brooch, embroidery on the bodice, a wide belt with a large oval pearl, and a red and gold sleeve on her left arm. She also wears a necklace with three cameo medallions connected by strands of pearls. The background features a textured oval frame with a neutral tone.

artworks.title: Princess Auguste Amelie of Bavaria
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. W. Murray Crane
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a woman with dark hair and a green fabric draped over her shoulders. She is turned slightly to her left and looking off into the distance. She wears an empire-style gown with a detailed pattern of white, silver, and golden colors with pleats and star motifs. A thin headband with a golden design is on her head, and she wears delicate drop earrings. The background is a dark, muted brown with swirling patterns.

artworks.title: Helvétius
artworks.artist: Pierre-Michel Alix after Jean-François Garnerey after Louis Michel Van Loo
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. W. Murray Crane
artworks.description: The image depicts a man's upper body. He is seated and facing slightly to his right, looking directly at the viewer. He has fair skin, light-colored eyes, and neatly styled white or grey hair that is curled and swept back from his face. His facial features include a prominent, rounded forehead and a small mouth. He is dressed in 18th-century attire, wearing a vivid blue coat over a patterned vest, and a high-collared white shirt with an elaborate cravat or necktie. The background is a simple brown color, enclosed within an oval frame, which is surrounded by a beige border with some text and light dotting. No visible jewelry or objects are held by the person in the portrait.

artworks.title: Le Général Buonaparte (Napoleon as General of the Italian Army)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. W. Murray Crane
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a person from the waist up, facing three-quarters to the right. The person has a stern expression and distinct facial features. They have medium length straight hair styled neatly and are dressed in a dark blue military-style coat with gold embroidery. There is a red fabric lining at the collar and cuffs, and they are wearing a light-colored glove on their right hand. The background has a brown textured pattern in an oval frame, against a muted marble-like design.

artworks.title: Jean Jacques Rousseau
artworks.medium: color etching and wash manner on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. W. Murray Crane
artworks.description: The portrait depicts a man with prominent features and gray hair styled in a traditional 18th-century fashion. He is wearing a coat with a high collar and a visible neckcloth. The background is a plain dark oval within a larger rectangular area. The subject is identified as Jean Jacques Rousseau. The portrait is rendered in a soft sepia tone.

artworks.title: Charlotte Corday
artworks.medium: color wash manner on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. W. Murray Crane
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a woman's upper body. She is slightly turned to her right with a neutral expression. Her facial features include wide eyes, arched eyebrows, and a small, closed mouth. Her hair is dark brown and styled in loose curls. She is wearing a white top draped around her shoulders, and a red shawl. There are no visible accessories. The background is a dark, neutral tone, with an oval frame and handwritten text below the portrait on aged paper.

artworks.title: Benjamin Franklin
artworks.artist: Jean-François Janinet and Joseph Siffred Duplessis
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. W. Murray Crane
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a man from the chest up. He is positioned facing slightly to the left, with a direct, level gaze. The man has a distinguished face with a prominent forehead and a gentle expression. His hair is long and gray, curling slightly around the shoulders. He is wearing a red-brown coat with a fur-trimmed collar and a white cravat peeking from underneath. The background is a neutral dark tone, with an oval border framing the portrait against a lighter rectangle that fills the rest of the image. There is text below the image identifying the person as Benjamin Franklin, with additional text in a decorative script style.

artworks.title: Henry IV
artworks.artist: Jean-François Janinet after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. W. Murray Crane
artworks.description: The image shows a head and shoulder portrait of a man in profile facing left. He has an older complexion with features such as a high forehead, bushy eyebrows, a long nose, a white beard and mustache, and white wavy hair. He wears a garment with a high collar over his shoulders. The background is dark, emphasizing the man's features against his light skin and white hair. The portrait is in an oval frame with text below identifying him as Henry IV, accompanied by French text. The surrounding area is plain beige.

artworks.title: Louis Seize
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. W. Murray Crane
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in a regal and confident position. He is facing slightly to the left, with his right hand holding a scepter and his left hand resting on a table adorned with a crown. The man has a well-coiffed hairstyle with curls, and his facial expression is composed. He is dressed in a royal blue velvet robe adorned with golden fleur-de-lis patterns and ermine trim, over a white lace shirt and pale blue tights. His attire is complemented with a decorative neckpiece and he is standing on a patterned carpet. The room around him is luxurious, with rich red drapery and ornate paneling in the background. A blue velvet-covered chair and a column with tassels hanging from the fabric above are also visible.

artworks.title: Lt. Colonel Tarleton
artworks.artist: John Raphael Smith after Sir Joshua Reynolds
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. W. Murray Crane
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a dynamic stance, with one knee bent. They have a fair complexion, layered hair, and wear a military-style uniform with a tall hat adorned with a plume. They hold a sword and are near a cannon. In the background, there are fabric drapes and a horse's head.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait, Frowning
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 7.3 x 6.2 cm (2 7/8 x 2 7/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of W.G. Russell Allen
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a male subject from the shoulders up. The subject is facing slightly to the right, with his head turned towards the viewer. His facial features are distinct, with deep-set eyes, a pronounced nose, and lips, framed by curly hair falling around his face and neck. He wears a heavy, textured cloak or garment draping over his shoulders. The background is plain and unadorned.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait (?) with Plumed Cap and Lowered Sabre
artworks.dimensions:
plate (oval): 13 x 10.6 cm (5 1/8 x 4 3/16 in.)
sheet (octagon): 15.3 x 12.8 cm (6 x 5 1/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of W.G. Russell Allen
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of an individual, shown from the chest upwards. The person is facing slightly to the right, with the head turned towards the viewer. They have long, curly hair and a beard, with prominent facial features including a mustache and full cheeks. The person is wearing a dark garment with a high, ruffled collar and a chain around the neck, as well as a cap with a feather. The background is plain with etched lines, and the portrait is in an oval frame with the signature "Rembrandt f. 1634."

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds: with the Lamp
artworks.medium: etching (and burin where biting failed in state i)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of W.G. Russell Allen
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures gathered in a rustic interior setting, possibly a stable or barn. In the center, a woman is holding a swaddled infant, partially covered by a cloth. Beside her is a bearded man leaning towards them. Other figures, possibly men and children, are around them, all dressed in simple clothing. On the right, a group of animals, including a cow, is also depicted. The background shows textured surfaces, likely wooden walls or beams, and some indistinct objects.

artworks.title: Christ Disputing with the Doctors: a Sketch
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 12.7 x 21.5 cm (5 x 8 7/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of W.G. Russell Allen
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crowded indoor scene featuring several figures gathered around a central character. The drawing is an intricate line work where a variety of figures are depicted in various poses. The scene seems to have a focal point where one figure stands apart from the others, pointing or presenting something. Details such as expressions and textures of clothing are suggested through fine lines and shading, creating a sense of depth and movement in the composition. The figures are mostly depicted in side profiles or three-quarter views. The style is reminiscent of detailed sketches from historical or religious scenes.

artworks.title: Christ Preaching (La petite Tombe)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of W.G. Russell Allen
artworks.description: This is a print of a man standing in the center of a gathering, surrounded by other people in a large space. The central man has raised hands and is standing on an elevated platform. He has a beard and long hair, and there is a halo around his head, with light emanating from it. The surrounding people are looking towards him, some sitting and some standing. The crowd includes men and women of all ages, wearing a variety of garments and head coverings. On the right is an arched opening that reveals other buildings in the distance.

artworks.title: Christ and the Woman of Samaria Among Ruins
artworks.creditLine: Gift of W.G. Russell Allen
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in conversation within ancient architectural ruins. The left figure is seated on a stone structure with long hair and a beard, wearing a flowing garment and gesturing with their hands. The right figure is standing and leaning over an architectural edge, holding a jug. The background features more ruins and a group of people observing the interaction. The image is in monochrome with detailed etching.
